PURPOSE: Tool authorization runtime for the WorkerAdapter direction: the agent+user authorization intersection (tri-state gate: ALLOW / REQUIRES_GRANT / DENY), per-action least-privilege enforcement at the tool layer, scoped credential injection into the execution context with a custody rule (agent channel never carries secrets), and a typed execution receipt (value | error(kind, can_retry, retry_after_ms, additional_prompt_content) | requires_authorization) that the orchestrator uses for retry/fallback routing and the independent verifier uses for mission verification
SMALLEST_MISSING_PRIMITIVE: Tri-state authorization verdict with scoped context injection: authorize(actor, owner, tool_ref, scopes) returns ALLOW (bound to opaque credential handles injected only inside the execution boundary), REQUIRES_GRANT (grant_id + challenge URL + scopes; resumable, not a failure), or DENY (terminal). PING capability evaluation answers boolean allow/deny; it has no resumable authorization state and no custody rule separating credential values from the worker observable channel. Receipt records the grant binding (execution_id, tool_ref, scopes, owner), never secret values.
